requires.label: Income not more than 250% FPL
requires.quote: (III)The patient’s annual family income is NOT more than two hundred fifty percent (250%) of the federal poverty guidelines.

rules.label: Self-Pay Discount
rules.quote: a.All uninsured patients receive a 40% Self-Pay discount on their account balance at the time of billing.

application.quote: (IV)The patient complies in supplying the necessary information to AVRMC within 182 days of requested date.

notes: Screening must occur within 45 days of date of service or discharge per Section 3.
Patients may apply up to three months prior to receiving service and eligibility is valid for one year after determination per Section 3(1)a.
Out-of-state Medicaid balances may be adjusted off as charity if application not feasible per Section 4(3).
The hospital may reverse financial assistance write-off if third-party coverage is discovered later per Section 3(1)f.
Opt-out requires a signed form; verbal decline is not valid per Section 3(2).
Hospital will contact patient monthly for six months after discharge if no opt-out per Section 3(2).
Patient may request cessation of contact; hospital must document per Section 3(2)c.
Policy effective for dates of service on or after September 1, 2022 per Section 1.
Policy guided by ACA regulations, Colorado state regulations, CICP, and HDC per Section 1.
0 may leave out a condition: Deadline is 182 days from requested date, which may differ from date of service.
